description: This file contains validation rules for form fields in the OrangeHRM project, including various data type checks, date and time validations, file validations, and formatting checks.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is present and non-empty, returns a boolean or an error message.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Creates a validation function to ensure string length does not exceed specified character limit.

methods.name: validDateFormat
methods.description: Returns a function that validates whether a date string matches a specified format.

methods.name: shouldBeCurrentOrPreviousDate
methods.description: Validates if a date is today or in the past.

methods.name: validTimeFormat
methods.description: Validates if a time string matches HH:mm format.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Creates a validation function to ensure a number is less than a specified maximum.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Checks if the string contains only digits.

methods.name: numericOnly
methods.description: Checks if the string contains only digits, ensuring numeric value.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPoint
methods.description: Checks if the string is a number with optional decimal point.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPointAndMinusSign
methods.description: Checks if the string is a signed decimal number.

methods.name: beforeDate
methods.description: Checks if date1 is before date2.

methods.name: afterDate
methods.description: Checks if date1 is after date2.

methods.name: sameDate
methods.description: Checks if date1 equals date2.

methods.name: endDateShouldBeAfterStartDate
methods.description: Validates that the end date is after the start date.

methods.name: beforeTime
methods.description: Checks if time1 is before time2.

methods.name: afterTime
methods.description: Checks if time1 is after time2.

methods.name: sameTime
methods.description: Checks if time1 equals time2.

methods.name: endTimeShouldBeAfterStartTime
methods.description: Validates that the end time is after the start time.

methods.name: maxFileSize
methods.description: Creates validation to check if a file size does not exceed the maximum.

methods.name: validFileTypes
methods.description: Checks if a file's type is within allowed types.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates email string format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates phone number string format.

methods.name: startDateShouldBeBeforeEndDate
methods.description: Validates that start date is before end date.

methods.name: maxCurrency
methods.description: Ensures currency value does not exceed maximum.

methods.name: startTimeShouldBeBeforeEndTime
methods.description: Validates that start time is before end time.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Validates string length is at least the specified amount.

methods.name: maxValueShouldBeGreaterThanMinValue
methods.description: Validates min value is less than the input value.

methods.name: minValueShouldBeLowerThanMaxValue
methods.description: Validates max value is greater than the input value.

methods.name: numberShouldBeBetweenMinAndMaxValue
methods.description: Checks if a number is within a specified range.

methods.name: validHexFormat
methods.description: Validates string as a valid hex color code.

methods.name: imageShouldHaveDimensions
methods.description: Validates image dimensions based on aspect ratio.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Validates number is at least a minimum value.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Validates number is at most a maximum value.

methods.name: validLangString
methods.description: Checks language string consistency, such as balanced braces.

methods.name: validSelection
methods.description: Validates selection is valid (not a string).

methods.name: validHostnameFormat
methods.description: Validates hostname or IP address format.

methods.name: validPortRange
methods.description: Validates port number within range and length.

methods.name: validVideoURL
methods.description: Validates if URL is a valid YouTube video link.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithTwoDecimalPoints
methods.description: Checks if string is a number with up to two decimal places.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: lessThanOrEqual
ctags.pattern: /^export const lessThanOrEqual = function (maxValue: number, message?: string) {$/

ctags.name: numericOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const numericOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validEmailFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validHostnameFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validHostnameFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validSelection
ctags.pattern: /^export const validSelection = function (value: string | object | null) {$/

ctags.name: validTimeFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validTimeFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validVideoURL
ctags.pattern: /^export const validVideoURL = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
